prompt: Which South Korean Cross-country skier had the highest rank at the Olympics in the Men's 15 km, among South Korean skiers only, between 2002 and 2006?
answer:
**Kim Hyun-tae** had the highest placing among South Korean skiers in the men’s 15 km cross-country event between the 2002 and 2006 Winter Olympics. His best result came at **Salt Lake City 2002**.  

Sources: [2002 results](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross-country_skiing_at_the_2002_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_15_kilometre) · [2006 results](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross-country_skiing_at_the_2006_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_15_kilometre)
